name: 4-Me-αMT
summary: 4-Me-αMT (developmental code name MP-809), or 4-Me-AMT, also known as 4-methyl-α-methyltryptamine or as 4,α-dimethyltryptamine (4,α-DMT), is an experimental antidepressant of the tryptamine and α-alkyltryptamine families that was never marketed. It is closely structurally related to serotonergic psychedelics and entactogens like α-methyltryptamine (αMT) and α-ethyltryptamine (αET).

pharmacology.text: It is closely structurally related to serotonergic psychedelics and entactogens like α-methyltryptamine (αMT) and α-ethyltryptamine (αET).

uses.text: 4-Me-αMT (developmental code name MP-809), or 4-Me-AMT, also known as 4-methyl-α-methyltryptamine or as 4,α-dimethyltryptamine (4,α-DMT), is an experimental antidepressant of the tryptamine and α-alkyltryptamine families that was never marketed.

summaryZh: α,4-二甲基色胺，分子式C12H16N2，是一種色胺衍生物，1960年代早期作為一種抗抑鬱藥開發出來，代號MP-809，但從未上市。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related α-alkyltryptamines such as αMT and αET can cause nausea, muscle tension, a racing heart, anxiety and restlessness, and can raise the risk of serotonin syndrome, which can be life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。相關的α-烷基色胺類（例如αMT與αET）可能引起噁心、肌肉緊繃、心跳急促、焦慮與坐立不安，也可能提高血清素症候群的風險，這種狀況可能危及生命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。相关的α-烷基色胺类（例如αMT与αET）可能引起恶心、肌肉紧绷、心跳急促、焦虑与坐立不安，也可能提高血清素症候群的风险，这种状况可能危及生命。

fact.en: It was developed as an experimental antidepressant but never marketed. Its simpler relative αMT went further and was briefly sold as an antidepressant called Indopan in the Soviet Union.
fact.zh: 它曾作為實驗性抗憂鬱藥開發，但從未上市。它較簡單的近親αMT走得更遠，曾以「Indopan」的名稱在蘇聯短暫作為抗憂鬱藥販售。
fact.zhHans: 它曾作为实验性抗忧郁药开发，但从未上市。它较简单的近亲αMT走得更远，曾以「Indopan」的名称在苏联短暂作为抗忧郁药贩售。
